message: Contentstack's live_preview config must use preview_token, not management_token — the delivery SDK reads preview_token; management_token is the wrong key and silently breaks preview. The npm package's own node_modules/contentstack/index.d.ts type declaration for LivePreview is STALE and incorrectly requires {host, management_token, enable} — the correct, reviewer-approved fix casts the real {enable, preview_token} shape through `as unknown as contentstack.LivePreview` rather than satisfying the wrong type structurally. A prior review already caught this exact defect (orchestrations/logs/review-agent-AMSD-2041.log).
